title: The Earth at night: where the world lit up and where it went dark
excerpt: Seen from space, the planet gave off 57% more light in 2024 than in 2012. Nepal's light grew 9.3 times and Africa's cities blazed up, while war halved the light of Ukraine and Yemen, and new LED street lamps made France look 40% darker than it is.
seo_description: Satellite night lights 2012 to 2024 mapped: where the world lit up, where it went dark through war and power cuts, and why LEDs fool the satellite.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The Earth at night' in black and gold on cream, beside a dark world map dotted with every lit place coloured by change from 2012 to 2024, gold where light grew and magenta where it fell. Text: the planet gave off 57% more light; Nepal's grew 9.3 times, while Ukraine and Yemen lost half of theirs.
